title: RBI Penalty Orders on Three NBFCs (August 3, 2026)
description: <cite index="27-2,27-6">RBI imposed penalties on Infinity Fincorp Solutions (Rs 5.40 lakh for KYC and Fair Practice Code violations) and Namdev Finvest (Rs 2.70 lakh for KYC non-compliance)</cite> based on supervisory inspections of their financial positions as of March 31, 2025.
